basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Staff Backend Engineer & AI Systems Lead | Python, PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP | Production LLM Pipelines with Evals & Decision Traces
basics.summary: Staff-level backend engineer with 13+ years shipping reliable systems around fragmented, high-value data. Currently Lead AI Engineer at LumApps: services, data models, async pipelines and evaluation loops for production multi-agent systems on Python + GCP (Pub/Sub, LangGraph, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request telemetry). Six years at Beekeeper on AWS (Python/Java, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elastic Search, Kubernetes) at 99.99% SLA under GDPR for 10M+ users, including an LLM pipeline that eliminated $337K in vendor cost in 6 weeks. Founder of SwissNRI, a compliance-first regulated fintech: comfortable where explainability, audit trails and long-horizon correctness matter as much as latency.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Design services, data models and async pipelines on Python + GCP for production multi-agent workflows (LangGraph, Google ADK on Vertex AI). Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub with automated cleaning, deduplication and versioning across 5+ enterprise data sources; 2x conversions, $1M/quarter revenue forecast.

Built the evaluation loop that makes stochastic AI behavior debuggable and explainable: LangSmith tracing, evals-as-tests, tool-selection tuning and cost-per-request telemetry. Same discipline the JD calls out for making decisions transparent.

Architected AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that captures every agent read/write as a timestamped, cited decision trace. A working intelligence layer over fragmented enterprise data.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Owned production backend infrastructure on AWS for 10M+ frontline users: Python/Java services on Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Kafka pipelines, Elastic Search, ClickHouse, Lambda / EC2. GDPR-sensitive workloads at 99.99% SLA on the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).
Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (Python + OpenAI + GitHub Actions). Rigorous measurement, direct P&L impact, product team unblocked.
Architected the Employee Referral System end-to-end: services, PostgreSQL data model, async job workflows and cross-team GTM. Same design lens applied to Search Platform revamp across 3 teams.
Global on-call, observability (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io); mentored the AI engineering cohort; proactive stakeholder communication with Product, Sales and CIO.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Ran discovery-style diligence on 20+ fintech and AI startups: system design, data architecture, moats and ROI framing. Direct, honest, challenge-the-idea communication with founders and CFOs.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling asynchronous algorithmic trading systems in production; advised portfolio companies on where AI creates real leverage.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off. Built the backend from scratch (Java, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD) for a live commercial platform that ran 500+ real-world deliveries.

Engineered real-time telemetry, flight-control APIs and logistics optimization. Enterprise-grade reliability that landed Unilever partnership and a CES showcase: every output auditable, every deployment verifiable.

education.institution: Quantic School of Business and Technology

publications.name: Your AI Needs a Brain, Not a Better Model
publications.summary: Reference guide to memory and RAG under an AI decision layer: temporal knowledge graphs vs vector-only, and how to build a data backbone agents can be trusted with.

publications.name: Drafted, not sent: how I built the second half of an AI outbound agent.
publications.summary: Verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and draft-before-send patterns to keep stochastic agents from shipping wrong actions in high-stakes workflows.

publications.name: I Built an AI Outbound Agent. Here's What Actually Worked.
publications.summary: Case study on the architecture and evaluation of a production AI agent that moved real business metrics. Where AI helps in a professional workflow and where it does not.

publications.name: Agentic AI: Simple ReAct Agent
publications.summary: Practical tutorial on ReAct agents that combine reasoning and action for long-horizon workflows.

awards.title: Appreciation from John T. Chambers (ex-CEO, Cisco Systems)

projects.name: SwissNRI - Compliance-First Regulated Fintech
projects.description: Production platform for Swiss-Indian cross-border tax and compliance decisions. Python + PostgreSQL backend, RAG-grounded assistant answering DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax with citations back to the regulation, and an agentic layer that flags risk before users act. Compliance-first design with regulator-verifiable outputs, PII controls and audit trails baked in from day one. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in user satisfaction.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent practice building production AI on customers' live data end-to-end: services, pipelines, evaluations and observability. Same operating model I would bring to Kalepa's core backend: own the problem, ship the fix, keep the decision explainable.

projects.name: PulseView - Live-Data AI Decision Engine
projects.description: Production platform ingesting real-time price and news time series (Python, async workers, structured storage), computing indicators and running agents that generate AND justify signals with cited evidence: if the model cannot explain the decision, it does not ship. Explainability, evaluation and back-testing built in.
